title: FRED Economic Indicators
description: Pulls targeted FRED economic series that directly map to Kalshi/Polymarket economic contracts: CPI, unemployment, Fed funds rate, GDP, yield spread, USD/EUR, gas prices, and mortgage rates. For each series captures latest and previous values with percent change. Leading indicator for economic event contracts - when FRED data shows a trend direction but contract pricing hasn't reflected it, that's the edge.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone

BASE = 'https://api.stlouisfed.org/fred/series/observations'
SERIES_BASE = 'https://api.stlouisfed.org/fred/series'
API_KEY = CREDENTIALS.get('FRED_API_KEY', '')
now_epoch = int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())

SERIES_IDS = ['CPIAUCSL', 'UNRATE', 'FEDFUNDS', 'GDP', 'T10Y2Y', 'DEXUSEU', 'GASREGW', 'MORTGAGE30US']
SERIES_NAMES = ['CPI All Urban Consumers', 'Unemployment Rate', 'Federal Funds Effective Rate', 'Gross Domestic Product', '10Y-2Y Treasury Spread', 'USD/EUR Exchange Rate', 'Regular Gas Price', '30-Year Mortgage Rate']
SERIES_MAPS = ['Kalshi CPI contracts', 'Kalshi employment contracts', 'Kalshi/Polymarket Fed rate contracts', 'Kalshi GDP contracts', 'Recession probability contracts', 'Currency event contracts', 'Energy/inflation contracts', 'Housing-related contracts']

rows = []

for i in range(len(SERIES_IDS)):
    series_id = SERIES_IDS[i]
    series_name = SERIES_NAMES[i]
    maps_to = SERIES_MAPS[i]
    try:
        resp = requests.get(
            BASE,
            params={
                'series_id': series_id,
                'api_key': API_KEY,
                'file_type': 'json',
                'sort_order': 'desc',
                'limit': 2,
            },
            timeout=30,
        )
        if resp.status_code == 429:
            retry = int(resp.headers.get('Retry-After', 5))
            time.sleep(retry)
            resp = requests.get(
                BASE,
                params={
                    'series_id': series_id,
                    'api_key': API_KEY,
                    'file_type': 'json',
                    'sort_order': 'desc',
                    'limit': 2,
                },
                timeout=30,
            )
        resp.raise_for_status()
    except Exception:
        continue
    obs = resp.json().get('observations', [])
    latest_val = None
    prev_val = None
    obs_date = ''
    for o in obs:
        if o.get('value', '.') != '.':
            if latest_val is None:
                latest_val = float(o['value'])
                obs_date = o.get('date', '')
            elif prev_val is None:
                prev_val = float(o['value'])
    pct_change = round((latest_val - prev_val) / abs(prev_val) * 100, 4) if latest_val is not None and prev_val is not None and prev_val != 0 else None
    # Get series metadata for units and frequency
    units = ''
    frequency = ''
    try:
        meta_resp = requests.get(
            SERIES_BASE,
            params={'series_id': series_id, 'api_key': API_KEY, 'file_type': 'json'},
            timeout=15,
        )
        if meta_resp.status_code == 200:
            sinfo = meta_resp.json().get('seriess', [])
            if sinfo:
                units = sinfo[0].get('units', '')
                frequency = sinfo[0].get('frequency', '')
    except Exception:
        pass
    rows.append({
        'series_id': series_id,
        'series_name': series_name,
        'latest_value': latest_val,
        'previous_value': prev_val,
        'pct_change': pct_change,
        'observation_date': obs_date,
        'release_date_epoch': 0,
        'units': units,
        'frequency': frequency,
        'maps_to': maps_to,
        '_epoch': now_epoch,
    })
    time.sleep(0.3)

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
